source_message.text: Hi Nadia! Separate from the Rcp project, I’m planning a response to an RFQ, and the work should be pretty straightforward. The scope covers packaging all content into one doc., along with layout, the org. chart, the budget sheet, and formatting. Although the response is due 9/16, I plan to submit it on 9/15. Would you be interested in helping me with this task? If so, could you provide the total cost? I’ll also send the RFQ shortly for reference. Thanks!

value_updates.organization_chart_inclusion: Include the organization chart in the packaged RFQ response document.
